name: RVRL Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in an eight-man tournament at RVRL's 2006 revival opener, won on a foreign-object shot in the final.

name: RVRL Missouri Valley Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: RVRL's secondary title, revived alongside the Heavyweight Championship and won in the same 2006 tournament by a competitor who used a handful of powder and a fistful of tights.
